steps.text: Hello mister secretary 😌
Random warning 😇
I need either {{name:aiden}} or {{name:mason}} to take me to rugby on Wednesday
I'm planning ahead because apparently that's what mature women do 😌
Who are you?
What have you done to my {{name:hailey}}
How dare you say that 😤
That's not how a proper majordomo is supposed to behave 😌
Are you a princess?
More like a frog to me
(I'm a grown woman, I'm a grown woman 😌)
( Don't kill him 😇)
How many of you are there in your head?
Enough to bury you in the garden 🌸
Anyway
How are you doing today?
Better than yesterday
Still slow though
Slow is fine, or more like your normal speed 😌
You better train to run fast
You'll see what happens to bad frogs when I'm fully healed
Threats don't reach my princess ears
Goodbye peasant 😇
